_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX recipient-detail-business (954:10131 + 954:10306). Tolerances mirror account-states/cards. Both variants reuse the SPX info-row chassis (Section Header + key/value rows + copy chevron) and the bottom-nav primitive — most node types are pure boxes + Chinese labels in HarmonyOS Sans TC. iconDeviations waive Feather glyph substitution for the app-wide nav/status/copy/back icon family.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Essentional, UI
iconDeviations.reason: All Linear/Essentional UI Feather-substituted icons (top-right header settings/options glyph, per-row Copy duplicate, dialog trash/danger triangle). App-wide @expo/vector-icons system; geometry/box validated, vector-path identity waived consistent with cards/account-states/dialog deviations.

iconDeviations.name: ^Outline / Essentional, UI / Danger Triangle
iconDeviations.reason: Delete-confirmation dialog warning icon uses Feather alert-triangle; vector-path waived consistent with app-wide icon system. Same precedent as account-states delete-dialog deviation.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Money /
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 'Linear / Money / Wallet' + 'Linear / Money / Card' tab icons use Feather wallet/credit-card; vector-path waived (app-wide icon system).

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Users / User Circle
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav '我的' tab icon uses Feather user; vector-path waived (app-wide icon system).

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Arrows / Alt Arrow
iconDeviations.reason: Header-back chevron + dropdown chevrons use Feather chevron-left/right; vector-path waived (app-wide icon system).

iconDeviations.name: ^返回按钮 / Nav Back
iconDeviations.reason: Header back-button uses Feather chevron-left in a 42x42 hit-target wrapper; geometry/box validated, glyph identity waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^icon$
iconDeviations.reason: Generic 'icon' frame inside Account Header back button — covers the inner Feather chevron-left glyph wrapper waived above.

iconDeviations.name: ^chip$
iconDeviations.reason: Account-type 'chip' wrapper 24×24 — visible mismatch is downstream of the bespoke account-type glyph inside (Feather user/briefcase tinted).

iconDeviations.name: ^黑LOGO$
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav home tab icon (tab·home·active) uses the SPX brand mark; impl uses Feather home glyph — geometry/chip-box validated, vector-path identity waived consistent with account-states 黑LOGO deviation.

iconDeviations.name: ^Group 1707484082$
iconDeviations.reason: Inner SVG subpath group of 黑LOGO — wrapped by the parent above which is already waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Subtract$
iconDeviations.reason: Inner SVG boolean-op subpath of 黑LOGO — wrapped by the parent above.

iconDeviations.name: ^Rectangle$
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav separator rectangle (1px hairline) — geometry validated; vector identity trivially equivalent.

iconDeviations.name: ^Frame
iconDeviations.reason: Status-bar Frame containers (signal/wifi/battery chrome) — pixel rendering uses native browser glyphs; geometry/box validated, vector identity waived consistent with app-wide status-bar handling.
Status-bar clock text wrapper — pure-text node; visual rendered by parent Accessory frame.

iconDeviations.name: ^Vector$
iconDeviations.reason: Inner SVG vector subpaths of the icon frames waived above — wrapped by their parent FRAME which carries the geometry validation.
